scenarios.title: Page 12 Evaluation Scenario: Python PEP Comprehension Scoping Discussion
scenarios.raw_text: Discussion Thread on Comprehension Scoping: In Python 2, list comprehension variables leaked into the outer function scope. Several proposals suggested keeping the Python 2 variable leaking behavior for backward compatibility. Core developers rejected retaining variable leakage because leaking comprehension variables creates subtle bugs and shadows outer variables unpredictably. The consensus decided that comprehension iteration variables have localized inner scope in Python 3. All alternative proposals to leak loop variables or dynamically bind them were firmly rejected.

scenarios.title: Go Generics Design Benchmark: Type Parameters vs Template Monomorphization
scenarios.raw_text: Go Issue #43651 & Design Discussion: Earlier proposals suggested C++-style template monomorphization and macro expansion for Go generics. Core maintainers rejected template macro expansion because unbounded monomorphization causes compiler slowdowns and massive binary code bloat. The language team decided on type parameter constraints via interfaces with dual-mode compilation. All proposals for macro-style template expansion without interface constraints were rejected.
